A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the terpene synthase gene from L. dulcis is functional in maize and can be used for metabolic engineering of sesquiterpenes, but the metabolic engineering approach is not sufficient to achieve fungal resistance in maize.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the metabolic pathway for the synthesis of geraniol in maize can be engineered, but that the accumulation of the aglicone is compromised by glycosylation.
metabolic engineering of terpenoid biosynthesis in maize is not straightforward.
